topic: Space per guest under a tent
summary: Plan about 12 sq ft per guest for a sit-down meal at round tables and about 8 sq ft per guest for a standing cocktail party, plus room for food, bars and a stage. One rental company keeps 25% of a tent's seating space for a dance floor, stage, buffet or bar. Aisles are usually 5 ft wide.
